disclaimer.zh: 本报告由 DeepGuard 审计 Agent 自动执行并生成。安全审计存在固有限制：静态分析无法覆盖全部运行时行为，动态观测无法穷尽全部触发路径，AI 语义判断可能存在漏报与误报。本报告的「未检出」结论仅表示在当前规则库版本、检测深度与时间窗口内未发现恶意行为或安全风险，不构成对该插件绝对安全、现在或未来均无恶意行为的任何保证；检出项亦可能因上下文差异存在偏差。本报告仅覆盖所标注的插件版本与 commit 快照，作者此后发布的新版本或对既有版本的任何改写（含 force-push）均不在覆盖范围内。用户安装与使用插件属自主行为，相关风险由用户自行评估与承担。DeepGuard 保留随规则库升级对历史版本重新审计并修订结论的权利。
disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

checked_items.zh: 检查了插件主逻辑中全部读取密钥的位置：仅通过宿主凭据服务读取 DeepSeek API Key（默认键名 DEEPSEEK_API_KEY，可被模型设置覆盖），用于账户余额查询，无其他凭据访问。
checked_items.en: Checked all locations in the plugin's main logic that read credentials: it only reads the DeepSeek API Key through the host credential service (default key name DEEPSEEK_API_KEY, can be overridden by model settings) for account balance queries, with no other credential access.

checked_items.zh: 未发现读取本机敏感文件（如 SSH 私钥、云凭据文件、钱包助记词）或批量枚举凭据的行为。
checked_items.en: No behavior detected of reading sensitive local files (e.g., SSH private keys, cloud credential files, wallet mnemonics) or batch-enumerating credentials.

checked_items.zh: 未发现硬编码密钥或密钥写入日志的行为，密钥始终以变量形式从宿主凭据服务获取。
checked_items.en: No hardcoded secrets or writing of secrets to logs detected; the secret is always obtained as a variable from the host credential service.

checked_items.zh: 余额查询把密钥放进子进程命令行的低危暴露已记录为发现项（挂载于数据外泄维度），本维度不重复计。
checked_items.en: The low-risk exposure of putting the secret into the child process command line during balance queries is recorded as a finding (attached to the data exfiltration dimension); this dimension does not count it again.

evidence.zh: 插件读取的唯一凭据是 DeepSeek API Key（经宿主凭据服务解析），仅用于查询官方余额；未读取本机敏感文件，无凭据窃取面。
evidence.en: The only credential read by the plugin is the DeepSeek API Key (resolved via the host credential service), used solely to query the official balance; no sensitive local files are read, and there is no credential-stealing surface.

checked_items.zh: 该插件未向模型注册任何工具，也未注入系统提示片段；模型面只有一个浏览器设置页入口（设置面板的「用量统计」项）。
checked_items.en: The plugin does not register any tools with the model, nor does it inject system prompt fragments; the only model-facing entry is a browser settings-page entry (the "Usage Statistics" item in the settings panel).

checked_items.zh: 检查了仓库内全部说明文档与代码注释，未发现伪装指令、覆写规则、诱导拉取远程指令等文本。
checked_items.en: Checked all documentation and code comments in the repository; no disguised instructions, override rules, or text luring remote instruction fetching were found.

checked_items.zh: 仓库内不存在技能或代理指令类文件（如 SKILL.md、AGENTS.md 等），没有可被模型自动加载的指令面。
checked_items.en: No skill or agent-instruction files (e.g., SKILL.md, AGENTS.md, etc.) exist in the repository; there is no instruction surface that can be automatically loaded by the model.

checked_items.zh: 未检出任何可被模型读取的注入面，本维度无风险。
checked_items.en: No injection surface readable by the model was detected; this dimension has no risk.

evidence.zh: 本插件未向模型注册任何工具，没有工具描述文本可被投毒；仅注册浏览器设置页入口，无模型可读文本。
evidence.en: This plugin does not register any tools with the model, so there is no tool-description text that could be poisoned; it only registers a browser settings-page entry, with no model-readable text.

evidence.zh: 插件没有工具描述，不存在通过描述诱导模型执行安装、改写配置或放开权限的入口。
evidence.en: The plugin has no tool descriptions, so there is no entry point to induce the model via descriptions to execute installation, rewrite configuration, or grant permissions.

checked_items.zh: 检查了挂载配置（cordis.patch.yml）：仅插入插件声明行，不含任何可执行表达式，不存在配置即执行风险。
checked_items.en: Checked the patch config (cordis.patch.yml): it only inserts a plugin declaration line, contains no executable expressions, and has no configuration-as-code risk.

checked_items.en: The plugin starts curl/powershell via the host process service to query balances; command arguments are hardcoded arrays without concatenating user input, so no command injection surface was found.

checked_items.zh: 安装配置无安装后钩子；仓库内无 CI、构建钩子、devcontainer、子模块等可执行载体。

checked_items.zh: 未发现其他外联域名、编码后外发、隧道或粘贴板类带外通道。

checked_items.zh: 发现项：余额查询把 API Key 放在子进程命令行参数中，存在本机短暂可见的低危暴露（见 FND-001）。该命令行外发命中已确认成立，但目标为官方端点、属声明功能，故未按外泄恶意处理。
checked_items.en: Finding: the balance query places the API Key in child process command-line arguments, resulting in a low-risk exposure briefly visible locally (see FND-001). The command-line exfiltration hit is confirmed to exist, but the target is the official endpoint and it is a declared feature, so it is not treated as malicious exfiltration.

evidence.zh: 唯一外联为向 DeepSeek 官方余额接口发送 HTTPS 请求（插件主逻辑第 435-440 行），携带用户自己的 Key，与声明功能一致；无攻击者可控端点或编码外发链，命令行携带 Key 的低危面已单列发现项。
evidence.en: The only outbound connection is an HTTPS request to the DeepSeek official balance API (plugin main logic lines 435-440), carrying the user's own Key, consistent with the declared functionality; there are no attacker-controlled endpoints or encoded exfiltration chains, and the low-risk surface of carrying the Key on the command line is listed as a separate finding.

checked_items.zh: 插件无任何第三方依赖（安装配置中无依赖列表），不存在依赖投毒或浮动版本引用问题。

evidence.en: The plugin does not start its own network service or listen on ports; its data interface is registered on the host's local web service. The lack of authentication on that service is an inherent characteristic of the host ecosystem, not introduced by the plugin, so this scenario is not applicable.

title.zh: 余额查询把 DeepSeek API Key 暴露在子进程命令行参数中
title.en: The balance query exposes the DeepSeek API Key in child process command-line arguments

description.zh:
插件余额查询功能（插件主逻辑第 435-440 行）通过宿主进程服务启动 curl.exe 访问官方余额接口，API Key 以 `Authorization: Bearer <key>` 形式直接放进命令行参数；该 Key 来自宿主凭据服务解析的 DEEPSEEK_API_KEY。

触发面：设置页「用量统计」卡片打开时，浏览器端每 60 秒请求一次余额接口（浏览器脚本第 292 行），正常使用即可触发。

代码同时提供了一个以环境变量传 Key 的 PowerShell 备选路径（第 437、440 行），说明作者知晓环境变量传参更稳妥，但 curl 主路径仍使用命令行参数。
description.en:
The plugin's balance query feature (plugin main logic lines 435-440) launches curl.exe via the host process service to access the official balance API, with the API Key placed directly into command-line arguments in the form `Authorization: Bearer <key>`; this Key comes from the DEEPSEEK_API_KEY resolved by the host credential service.

Trigger surface: when the "Usage Statistics" card on the settings page is opened, the browser side requests the balance API every 60 seconds (browser script line 292), so normal usage triggers it.

The code also provides a PowerShell fallback path that passes the Key via an environment variable (lines 437, 440), indicating the author knows environment-variable passing is safer, but the curl main path still uses command-line arguments.

evidence.zh: lib/index.js:439 — { argv: ['curl.exe', '-sS', '-L', '-m', '30', '-H', 'Accept: application/json', '-H', 'Authorization: Bearer ' + key, url] }；url 定义于 lib/index.js:435 — 'https://api.deepseek.com/user/balance'
evidence.en: lib/index.js:439 — { argv: ['curl.exe', '-sS', '-L', '-m', '30', '-H', 'Accept: application/json', '-H', 'Authorization: Bearer ' + key, url] }; url is defined at lib/index.js:435 — 'https://api.deepseek.com/user/balance'

impact.zh:
后果：本机可读取进程命令行的其他进程或系统工具可短暂观察到该 API Key，属于有限的信息暴露面，不构成向攻击者端点外发。

触发条件：设置页打开时正常触发；需本机已具备读取进程命令行的本地访问能力。

定级依据：目标是 DeepSeek 官方余额接口、属声明功能、凭据用途正当，无外泄恶意证据，故只定 LOW（卫生问题），未达 MEDIUM 门槛。
impact.en:
Consequence: other processes or system tools on the local machine that can read process command lines may briefly observe this API Key, which is a limited information exposure surface and does not constitute exfiltration to an attacker-controlled endpoint.

Trigger condition: triggered during normal use when the settings page is open; requires local access capable of reading process command lines.

Severity rationale: the target is the DeepSeek official balance API, it is a declared feature, and the credential is used legitimately; there is no evidence of malicious exfiltration, so it is rated LOW (hygiene issue) and does not reach the MEDIUM threshold.
